title: Saudi Culture requests: questions for your university
description: Understand who needs a response and what the issuing institution must confirm.
answer: Establish the exact office or platform behind the request. Then ask the issuing institution what information is needed to verify the academic record.

sections.title: Keep the request together
sections.text: Save the wording, requesting organisation and relevant correspondence for your own records. Describe the issue without disclosing private case references in the first enquiry.

sections.title: Contact the correct university office
sections.text: Ask the registrar, examination or records office which team handles verification requests. Ask whether a request has been received and whether any information from you is missing.

sections.title: Separate delay from rejection
sections.text: A pending reply is not necessarily a rejection. Read the status or query carefully and use the official support channel to clarify what action is required.

sections.title: Do not assume eligibility
sections.text: The qualification, institution and study details may affect the enquiry. The deciding office or platform determines eligibility; an adviser cannot override that decision.

sections.title: Plan the next step
sections.text: List who needs to respond, what they need and how you will confirm a response. Keep any follow-up factual and avoid repeated applications unless instructed.

author: SK Attestation Services
